expected_behavior: A publication approval remains bound to the exact candidate packet reviewed by the human release owner.
failure_command: dispatch release.yml twice with release_tag=v0.9.0 and confirm_publication=false; download and compare release-candidate-v0.9.0/release-approval-packet.json
impact: A confirmed publication dispatch regenerated the packet after its approval record was supplied, so normal verifier-output variance could make every exact digest-bound approval fail closed.
repair: A confirmed dispatch must download the exact candidate artifact from the approved preparation-only workflow run, must not rerun release preparation, and must re-hash the complete artifact set against the approved packet before any protected write.

review.finding: P1: verify downloaded artifact digests against the approved packet
